title: Sakuzyo削除 over Lena Raine
description:
removes every single Lena Raine song in the game and replaces it with tracks made by the Artcore and Electronic composer Sakuzyo削除. 

JAPANESE TRANSLATION INGAME MIGHT BE INACCURATE ( still learning :( )
body:
Hey, this is my first resource pack ever. I made it for myself because I personally don't like any of the Lena Raine tracks ( I just feel like they don't fit minecraft. )

I replaced them in this pack with music by Sakuzyo, an electronic and artcore producer whos music I enjoy. The list of songs is in the pack and the pack supports 1.21. 

Japanese translation of track names within the pack may be innacurate, ごめなさい。

Please go listen to Sakuzyo here！[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC58hIFa6J8zRm3dKg7exQ2Q](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC58hIFa6J8zRm3dKg7exQ2Q)
